additionalRules: Hero warband/follower system (current 'Armies of The Lord of the Rings' edition): each Hero anchors a warband of Independent (non-Hero) followers up to a cap set by their tier for this army list — Hero of Legend: up to 18 followers; Hero of Valour: up to 15; Hero of Fortitude: up to 12; Minor Hero: up to 6; Independent Hero: 0 (occupies a slot in another Hero's warband instead). The army's General is typically a Hero of Valour or Hero of Legend — check this army list's own requirements. Heroic tier is assigned per army list, not an inherent property of the hero.

specialRules.name: Morgul Arrows
specialRules.text: Any enemy model that suffers an unprevented Wound from a friendly shooting attack must roll a D6 in the End Phase of every subsequent turn; on a 1 it suffers a further Wound. A model only rolls once per End Phase, even with multiple such Wounds.

specialRules.name: "They Strike in the wee small hours when everyone's asleep"
specialRules.text: An Azog's Hunters Army has a Bow Limit of 50% rather than the usual 33%.

specialRules.name: Relentless Hunters
specialRules.text: All models in this Army List gain the Woodland Creature and Mountain Dweller special rules.

specialRules.name: The Pale Orc's Demands
specialRules.text: Whilst within 6" of a friendly Hero, friendly Orc Warrior models gain a bonus of +1 to any Courage Tests to Charge an enemy model with the Terror special rule.

specialRules.name: Savage Hunters
specialRules.text: This model gains a bonus of +1 Attacks on a turn in which it Charges.

specialRules.name: Savage Hunters
specialRules.text: This model gains a bonus of +1 Attacks on a turn in which it Charges.

specialRules.name: Hunt Master
specialRules.text: Whilst he has the Cavalry keyword, Fimbul does not suffer penalties Moving through Difficult Terrain (and may still gain Charge bonuses there), and gains +1 Fight Value on a turn in which he Charges.

specialRules.name: Savage Hunters
specialRules.text: This model gains a bonus of +1 Attacks on a turn in which it Charges.

specialRules.name: Lethal Aim
specialRules.text: Each turn, Narzug gains a free Might Point that can only be spent during a shooting attack, on a To Hit Roll, To Wound Roll, or an In The Way Test; lost if unspent by the end of the turn.

specialRules.name: The Price of Failure
specialRules.text: If within 3" of Azog at the start of a Combat, Yazneg may declare he is using this rule before the Duel Roll to re-roll any number of dice; if he then loses the Duel Roll, he immediately suffers a Wound.

specialRules.name: The Bringer of Death
specialRules.text: Track Bolg's kills in Combat: at 2+ kills he gains Terror; at 5+ kills he gains Harbinger of Evil (12"); at 8+ kills he gains Mighty Hero.

specialRules.name: Stone Flail
specialRules.text: A Unique two-handed weapon. While using it, Azog gains Mighty Blow but his Fight Value is reduced to 6 for the Combat (even after a Heroic Strike); a model struck and not slain is knocked Prone at the end of the Combat.

specialRules.name: General of the North
specialRules.text: The range of Azog's Stand Fast is 12" rather than 6", and friendly Orc Hero models can benefit from it.

specialRules.name: I am the Master
specialRules.text: When making Strikes against an enemy Hero, a natural 3+ always counts as a successful To Wound Roll regardless of the Hero's Defence.

specialRules.name: Pack Master
specialRules.text: Once separated from Azog, only Warg models may benefit from its Heroic Actions or Stand Fast.

sourceNotes: Composition/points from the prancingponypub army list page; full profiles from the Gundabad & Dol Guldur forces page. In this list Azog's base points (175) do not include Heavy Armour, which is listed as a separate option.
